shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surged past $80K (up 25% weekly) due to institutional interest, but 'Extreme Greed' sentiment might precede corrections.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $2.6B net inflows last week, the highest since Oct 2025, indicating strong institutional demand.
US Treasury bond buybacks are weakening the dollar and lowering yields, diverting investors toward risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
Investors are awaiting the Jackson Hole Symposium with Fed Chair speech and key US PCE/GDP data for monetary policy insights.
